content.short: forgivenet is the world's first spiritual tech that encourages people to forgive others.
content.description: forgivenet is a Web3 social platform focused on forgiveness and emotional wellness. It frames forgiveness as a social currency and aims to build a community around that idea. The project is open-source, inviting collaboration as it grows. Users can request forgiveness from people they've wronged and receive an FRGVN token in return, creating a tangible digital acknowledgment of the act within the network. By tying social actions to a token, forgivenet encourages thoughtful interaction, accountability, and ongoing engagement within the community.
